intro: Community Analytics is a private local counter, not a platform analytics replacement. It uses Viewer Foundation identities to count observed stream attendance, messages, and commands across enabled platforms without retaining chat text, display names, avatars, money, or raw events.

sections.title: 1. Choose what gets counted
sections.description: Viewer Foundation must be installed, enabled, and healthy first.
sections.notice: Leave simulated events off for normal use. Community Analytics listens to the existing main platform intakes; it needs no separate Streamer.bot import or trigger.

sections.title: 2. Exclude accounts from local counting
sections.description: Bots and system actors are skipped automatically.
sections.notice: Use platform|stable-user-id for a platform account, or a Viewer Foundation ID for a linked viewer. Names are intentionally not accepted because they can change or collide.

sections.title: 3. Optional monthly participation score
sections.description: Turn this on only if another feature needs a bounded engagement score or rank.
sections.notice: This is not a currency or financial score. Only capped observed sessions, messages, and commands contribute. Money, subscriptions, gifts, Bits, Jewels, donations, and provider support never add points.

sections.title: 4. Advanced local storage limits
sections.description: Defaults are suitable for most channels.
sections.notice: Oldest records are removed at these bounds. Stored data is limited to Viewer Foundation IDs, timestamps, attendance, counters, capped score inputs, and replay fingerprints.

sections.title: 5. View and export results
sections.description: Save and restart first, then use the Reports section below.
sections.notice: Refresh session summary for a quick check. Session JSON contains aggregate stream totals; viewer CSV contains pseudonymous per-viewer counters. Neither is official platform, revenue, payout, or tax reporting.
